pr_body:
Previously, it was possible to have:

 - both threads start
 - One sits in the submit update task
 - The other has not even scheduled to run yet
 - Latch counts down
 - Thread 1 finishes, allowing another submit task
 - Thread 2 now gets scheduled and ran and submits a cluster update request

Fixes #76337
pr_title: Make persistent task cluster service test more stable

review_comment: Should this now be exactly once instead of at least once?  If not, please add a comment to say why there might be more than one.

@droberts195 the `atLeastOnce` is because these `verify` checks are also present after the test has ran. If I did `1` time only, the test would fail because there is a valid execution later (when both have finished executing making sure the atomicboolean is unset).
